reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Scale up TB and HIV interventions in Tanzania - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), HIV, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To achieve universal access to comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment, care and support services in order to significantly minimise the transmission of new HIV infections and reduce HIV-related mortality, stigma and discrimination. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Increased adoption of safer sexual practices (reduced risk behaviours), increased healthier behaviours and increased uptake of comprehensive HIV and AIDS services (prevention, treatment, care and support). Objective 2: Increased utilization of condoms during high-risk sex among women and men aged between 15-49 years.. Objective 3: 80% of all eligible PLHIVs are put on and retained on appropriate ART regimen by the year 2017. Objective 4: 100% of HIV patients are screened for TB by 2017.

TCS Other-1: Percentage of adults currently receiving antiretroviral therapy among all adults living with HIV
TCC Other-2: Percentage of Children (<15yrs) currently receiving antiretrovial therapy among all Children eligible for ARVs
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status

Percentage of young people aged 15-24 who are living with HIV
Outcome indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP01
